phase_prompt.label: Default
phase_prompt.summary: Gate fully operational, iris open, plasma sphere emerging.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: The gate stands in its default state: a massive obsidian archway with a spiraling iris of crystalline blades open, projecting cool‑white light onto the obsidian floor. A blue‑white plasma sphere hovers above the gate, its core faintly visible, while heat distortion ripples in the air. Fog catches the light beams, creating a cinematic, photorealistic scene.
